manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Watch a tossed ball slow to a stop at the top and fall back down while gravity pulls downward continuously.
manifest.description: A vertical axis shows the height of a tossed ball over time. As it rises, its upward velocity arrow shrinks to zero at the apex before pointing downward, while the gravity arrow remains constant.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
